reviewItem.question: For "Cache the full DNS response and handle TTL expiration in `FindZoneByFqdn`", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether cert-manager performs FindZoneByFqdn DNS zone-discovery lookups at runtime (e.g. while solving DNS challenges) and the TTLs of the responses being cached

proposed.statement: In cert-manager 1.18.0, FindZoneByFqdn now caches the full DNS response and handles TTL expiration of the cached response during DNS zone discovery.
